boundary: Discovery and targeted source review only. Candidates are excluded from catalog coverage totals. No media or text downloaded, mirrored, or systematically retrieved.

resources.title: Fasting for the Safety of the Little Ones
resources.reviewState: Target passage treatment inspected; substantial explanation of humility, reliance on God and fasting in verses 21-23 under Ezra's Fast, with contextual discussion under What Happened in Ezra's Day.
resources.contribution: Adds a second preacher and three currently unassigned main-text verses in Ezra. An occasional sermon, not a complete Ezra series. Contemporary political/medical claims are outside this passage audit and are not independently endorsed or verified.
resources.method: Retain bibliographic facts and official links. No whole-text republication or audio re-upload. Any future embed must satisfy current policy; systematic retrieval requires a separate access decision.
resources.nextAction: Admit a source-link record, verify recording duration and series position, and transfer this scoped assessment through normal editorial review.

resources.title: Eagle Edom Will Come Down
resources.reviewState: Body inspected: Judgment Pronounced Against Edom, Edom's Pride and Hope for Those in Zion explain verses 1-9, 10-16 and 17-21 as successive units.
resources.contribution: A sustained whole-book treatment that could add twenty currently unassigned main-text verses and a second preacher. Piper's covenant/inheritance interpretation remains his own; not a merged consensus reading.
resources.method: Official links only under this mission; no text/media republication or automated archive retrieval.
resources.nextAction: Verify recording metadata and admit the sermon with an explicit body-review locator. Inventory the Minor Prophets series separately before claiming series completeness.

resources.title: Take Courage: You Build More Than You See
resources.reviewState: Body inspected: A Paltry Replacement?, Take Courage, Work, Fear Not, and Fulfillment of the Prophecy sustain explanation of 2:1-9; the introduction explicitly names this focus.
resources.contribution: Adds a third mapped preacher and targets seven currently unassigned verses within 2:1-9. Two of those verses (4-5) already occur in an unresolved Spurgeon reference, so part of the apparent gap is metadata debt. Chapter 1 remains unmapped. Whole-book source tagging does not establish exposition of all 38 verses.
resources.method: Official links only under this mission; no text/media republication or automated archive retrieval.
resources.nextAction: Admit bounded passage metadata after recording checks; keep source-assigned Haggai and reviewed 2:1-9 scope distinct.

resources.title: The Sermons of M. Iohn Calvin upon the fifth booke of Moses called Deuteronomie
resources.bibliography: English edition, London: Henry Middleton for Thomas Woodcocke; Princeton Theological Seminary catalog describes 1,408 pages. Page count and date are catalog facts, not independently verified scan collation.
resources.reviewState: Edition bibliography verified on the contributing library's record. Contents, sermon boundaries and passage extents await scan review.
resources.contribution: Promising substantial historical corpus for an underserved long book, with a different preacher and era. No numerical gap closure claimed before component indexing.
resources.method: Library labels this edition No Known Copyright. Confirm the linked asset and source access conditions before retrieval; this is not an unrestricted license for every modern Calvin edition.
resources.nextAction: Collate the 1583 scan and contents, retain original sermon/page references, separate prefatory matter, then admit individual units. Avoid substituting a modern curated or translated edition.
